title: Donuts and Cupcakes
statementMd:
Bira's cooking skills have made him famous across the country, earning him an invitation to compete in the prestigious *MasterChef: Pastry Edition*! For the Halloween episode, he has prepared a mouthwatering tray of donuts and cupcakes. The 𝑛n treats are arranged in a single row, represented by a string 𝑠s: each `D` represents a donut and each `C` represents a cupcake.

Just as he finishes, Bira remembers that the judges also care about presentation! This time, they require every segment of five consecutive treats to contain exactly one donut and four cupcakes.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e432a590fd151a1e6b74581137914d1118c6b8b4.png)

Bira must hurry to rearrange his tray. He may reorder the treats however he likes, but must use every treat he has made, without adding, removing, or changing any of them. Help him find an arrangement that meets the judges' requirement, or determine that it is impossible.

## Input

The first line contains an integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤1051≤t≤105), the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of two lines. The first contains an integer 𝑛n (5≤𝑛≤2×1055≤n≤2×105), the number of treats. The second contains a string 𝑠s of length 𝑛n, consisting only of `D` and `C`, describing their initial arrangement.

The sum of 𝑛n over all test cases does not exceed 2×1052×105.

## Output

For each test case, print `-1` on a single line if no arrangement of Bira's treats meets the requirement.

Otherwise, print a string of length 𝑛n representing a valid arrangement. It must contain the same number of each character as 𝑠s. If several valid answers exist, print any of them.
